dedupe_keys.name: climapower european weather driven supply and demand series

description: Climapower publishes European country-level wind and solar capacity factors, hydropower inflows, heating demand and cooling demand for energy-system analysis. Antonini and collaborators derive historical inputs from ERA5 for 1940–2023 and future inputs from three CMIP5 EURO-CORDEX models for 2006–2100 under RCP 2.6, 4.5 and 8.5. Coverage includes the EU27, Balkan countries, the United Kingdom, Norway and Switzerland. Separate NetCDF files represent onshore and offshore wind, conventional and pumped-storage hydro, run-of-river hydro and demand categories, with calibration coefficients where observations were available. The precise time step was not established from the inspected repository metadata. The latest Zenodo record, published 16 October 2024, provides free ZIP archives under CC BY 4.0; the generating GitHub code uses GPL 3.0. A limitation is that these are model-derived national aggregates, not plant-level observations, and calibration availability differs by country. Simulation uses include renewable supply scenarios, adequacy studies and climate-sensitive demand inputs. It relates to model-atlite and data-era5-reanalysis. The original curated link pointed to an earlier version; the verified latest record is used here.
